_README: PII-FREE expected outcomes for the document-recognition eval harness. The document FILES live in fixtures/ (gitignored), their cached Gemini reads in snapshots/ (gitignored), and the per-doc profile context in context.json (gitignored). This file holds ONLY assertions about what the pipeline should conclude, so it is safe to commit. Add one entry per document under 'docs', keyed by the fixture filename WITHOUT its extension. See README.md.

offer_letter_actually_spm.note: Real case spotted in the cockpit: SPM results uploaded as an offer letter. Must be flagged, not accepted.

ic_clean.note: A clean student IC whose name + NRIC match the profile.

water_bill_other_name.note: Bill in another person's name — soft signal only, never a hard mismatch (accepted).

_regressions_README: TD-151 (1), 2026-10-02. The PROBLEM-DOCUMENT corpus: every document that once caused a misread fix, with a PII-free assertion about the corrected reading. Keyed by the snapshot stem. Replayed by hand with `python apps/scholarship/eval/regression_check.py` (never collected by pytest - the snapshots are gitignored PII); the committed tests run the same checks on synthetic twins (tests/test_regression_corpus.py). An entry with `"local": false` names a case not yet in the local corpus: capture it (fetch_corpus.py / capture_ocr.py) and switch the flag. Add a case here whenever a document drives a fix.

results_slip__a66__d912.note: Two-column SPM slip half-read by the positional parser (6/10 subjects, 3/4 grades mis-paired). The guard is the total the slip prints about itself: it must still be found and equal what the read kept.

salary_slip__a66__d915.note: Hand-written voucher whose ringgit|sen columns were concatenated (RM326.00 read as 32600, a false per-capita over the B40 line). The stored read must give a monthly figure inside the plausibility window, or none at all.

epf__a37__d411.note: An STR screenshot uploaded in the EPF slot (TD-117). The signature model must call it not an EPF statement, and the KWSP parser must not read it as a Penyata Ahli.

results_slip__a140__clipped_certificate.note: Certificate scanned with its left edge trimmed, so the total line prints 'JMLAH MATA PELAJARAN' (TD-217). The clip-tolerant anchor must still find the declared total. Synthetic twin: tests/test_clipped_subject_total.py.

salary_slip__a73__father_payslip.note: Scanned payslip whose IC number read with two digits wrong (state code and one serial digit) against the father's MyKad and STR (TD-220). OPEN: reading fewer digits wrongly has no bounded fix yet (TD-151), so no assertion is written; capture it so the next extraction change can be measured against it.
